author: Codex (GPT-5)

selection_reason.hardware_fit: The 4-bit artifact is approximately 16.1 GB and fits the 48 GB unified-memory host with rollback models retained.
selection_reason.quality_basis: The official Qwen3.5 model card reports the dense 27B ahead of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on several instruction, knowledge and long-context benchmarks.
rejected_primary_candidates: Gemma 4 MLX 4-bit candidates were too close to or above the host memory envelope for a reliable batch worker.
Smaller Ministral and Qwen variants remain useful speed candidates but are not the highest-quality replacement that fits this host.

qualification.source_quote_protocol: The model selects PDF page and source line range; the worker materializes exact quotes from frozen source text.

limits: This is a maker qualification, not authority to approve layout-sensitive OCR or image claims.
Taiwan names remain a separate public-source resolution gate.
The model does not create embeddings; embedding remains a later, rebuildable derivative stage.
